list.text: \f[lance]\bLance: Are you all right?
\f[lance]\bYour Pokémon are hurt and tired.\nHere, give them some of my medicine.
\f[lance]\b\PN, let's give our best for Pokémon.
The door is close, it needs a password to open.
You rotten little pest!
Heh, only the one one who guards the boss's room knows the password for that door.
Where's the boss's room?\nWho knows? Go look for yourself.
The door won't open?
Well, duh. It has to have a password that only Team Rocket knows.
Heh, I'm just a Team Rocket Grunt.\nI don't know the password.\nToo bad for you.
Oh, a kid? I don't really like this, but eliminate you I must.
I got wiped out on the last mission by a kid, too. When we were abducting Pokémon, this kid with long red hair and mean-looking eyes just whomped me...
\f[faceAriana]\rAriana: Hold it right there!
\f[faceAriana]\rWe can't let a brat like you do as you please forever.
\f[faceAriana]\rIt'll hurt Team Rocket's pride over and over again. Making it lessen, you see.
\f[faceAriana]\r...So, it's time to finish you. However strong you may be, if the two of us fight at the same time, you'll have no chance of winning. Don't you agree?
\f[faceAriana]\rHee hee hee! Sorry, baby. Now, get ready to be thrashed.
\f[lance]\bLance: Hold it!
\f[lance]\bA two-on-one battle?\nThat is so unfair!
\f[lance]\bTypical of Team Rocket to be so sneaky. Allow me to join battle!
\f[faceAriana]\rWhat? You had an accomplice? Where is your sense of dignity?
\f[faceAriana]\rAs interim boss in place of Giovanni, I'll show you how wrong it is to meddle with Team Rocket!
\f[faceAriana]\rBut that's fine. The broadcast experiment was a total success.
\f[faceAriana]\rIt doesn't matter what happens to this hideout now.
\f[faceAriana]\rWe have much bigger plans.\nYou'll come to appreciate Team Rocket's true power soon enough.
\f[faceAriana]\rEnjoy yourself while you can...\nHee hee hee...
\f[lance]\bSorry \PN. I saw how well you were doing, so I just hung back.
\f[lance]\bNow all there is left to do is to turn off that odd radio signal.
\f[lance]\bIt's this machine that's causing all the problems. I don't see a switch on it...
\f[lance]\bWe have no choice. We have to make all the VOLTORB faint.
\f[lance]\bThat should stop this machine from transmitting that strange signal.
\f[lance]\bIt's no fault of the VOLTORB, so it makes me feel sad.
\f[lance]\b\PN, let's split the job.

list.text: \f[lance]\bLance: That odd signal has finally stopped. The lake should be back to normal. You're the best!
\f[lance]\bLet me thank you on behalf of all the Pokémon. Oh, yes. You should take this.
\f[lance]\bI found it here, but I don't have any need for it.
\f[lance]\bThat's Fly.
\f[lance]\bTeach it to a Pokémon to attack fly up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.
\f[lance]\b\PN...
\f[lance]\bThe journey to becoming the Pokémon Champion is long and difficult.
\f[lance]\bKnowing that, will you keep going?
\f[lance]\bI see. No, you're right.
\f[lance]\bIf you would give up that easily, you would have never chased that dream in the first place.
\f[lance]\bI look forward to seeing you again!
